_meta.description: Opening of the demo video (about 32 s): the record is public but unread; OWL reads it; the vision; record, not label. The first two lines play over the teammate's original footage (tools/demo/out/opening-src.mp4).

segments.text: This is a House committee report. It's public, and this Congress has published hundreds of them.
Almost nobody reads them. So voters go by the party label.
That's why we built OWL, Open Watch on Legislators. It reads that record for you: 451 House members and 20,608 statements, each one click from its source.
Our vision is simple. Every claim about a politician comes with their exact words, and the place they said them.
So you can judge them on the record, not the label.
